description: Java class 'SecuredFreemarker' provides security features to prevent Freemarker template injection attacks by detecting and sanitizing Freemarker interpolation patterns in HTTP request parameters, URL, and response contexts. It contains methods for detecting Freemarker template strings, blocking dangerous content, and sanitizing parameters to ensure security.

classes.name: SecuredFreemarker
classes.description: Utility class for detecting and sanitizing Freemarker template injection in HTTP request and response data.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Checks if the given string contains any Freemarker interpolation strings based on a predefined list.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Overloaded method that checks if the given HTTP response and URI contain Freemarker interpolation patterns, and blocks the request if so.

methods.name: sanitizeParameterMap
methods.description: Sanitizes a map of parameters by replacing Freemarker interpolation patterns with safe placeholders.
